text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco and France sign a cooperation accord for merchant shipping.
- South Korean Daewoo buys Hyatt Regency hotel in Rabat.
- Heavy rains expected in several Moroccan regions on Sunday and Monday.
- King Hassan receives visiting French Transport Minister, Bernard Pons.
- Morocco's exports to increase by 12 percent rate in the next years, officials say.
- Spain's government approves new loans to Morocco.
